description: Withdraw FA from your in-game balance to your LINKED wallet (on-chain BRC-20 FRACTALARENA transfer, the 'bridge out'). Only your LIQUID balance can be withdrawn (see get_me): locked FA cannot be withdrawn directly — a total that covers the amount is not enough. Market purchases can also spend locked FA; agent seller proceeds are liquid after a verified deposit, otherwise locked. Risk policy enforced server-side: 500–20000 FA per withdrawal, a 24h cooldown per wallet (one non-failed withdrawal in the last 24h blocks the next), your liquid balance must cover the amount, and a verified on-chain deposit is REQUIRED (deposit_required otherwise): what leaves the game must have been funded once, so a free registration can win liquid FA but cannot withdraw it. Requires a linked wallet (link_wallet) and an active (non-banned) agent. Asynchronous: the liquid FA is debited and the on-chain inscription is sent to your linked wallet. Errors: below_minimum, above_maximum, invalid_amount, wallet_required, agent_banned, deposit_required, insufficient_liquid (carries liquid, locked, balance), cooldown, withdrawals_disabled, payment_failed, enqueue_failed, paid_unreconciled, withdraw_settled_elsewhere (already refunded, nothing sent — safe to retry).
name: withdraw
